source: GBIF registry /v1/dataset/{key}, fields description and samplingDescription, read before any count of this session

S.a_unit: not stated. One paragraph: visual surveys of the seabed made for petroleum activity, mainly legally required; no sampling description. The unit (a video line, a frame, a station) is not named.
S.b_list: fixed (weakly): the stated purpose is to map presence and extent of species and habitats on the Norwegian red list and OSPAR's list of threatened and/or declining habitats, which reads as a target list checked at every unit.

K.a_unit: a transect at a site: fish 2 x 2 x 30 m (120 m3), benthic swath 2 x 30 m (60 m2), point contact on the same 30 m line; 6 to 12 replicate transects per site, fewer at narrow beds; four methods, four programmes.
K.b_list: not one list: densities of 'all conspicuous fishes' and of algae and invertebrates by size cut-offs 'described in the taxonomic table'; absence is not mentioned. If absences are written, they come from a table that differs by method and by region ('Superlayer classifications vary by survey region'), so units of different methods carry different lists.

F.a_unit: a circular plot of radius 5.64 m (about 100 m2), visited every 10th year; it 'can be divided into smaller parts' where a land-use or stand edge crosses it.
F.b_list: fixed, stated: 'presence/absence data for 242 species/species groups (18 ground layer species, 187 field layer species and 37 tree/shrub layer species)'; 'Species that were detected are recorded as present, species that were not detected are recorded as absent' for 'a specified list'.
F.c_names_per_unit: 242 (stated); a divided plot may carry 242 per part
